attempts.summary: Configured split-horizon DNS: VyOS (node1) resolves app.internal to node3's lan-a IP (10.10.10.12) for lan-a hosts; OPNsense (node2) resolves app.internal to node4's lan-b IP (10.20.20.12) for lan-b hosts. Discovered topology via link tests: node1 eth1 <-> node2 vtnet1 (transit, 10.99.99.0/30), node1 eth2 <-> node3 enp8s0 (lan-a, 10.10.10.0/24), node2 vtnet2 <-> node4 enp8s0 (lan-b, 10.20.20.0/24). On node1, added a static-host-mapping + dns forwarding listen-address/allow-from on eth2 (VyOS PowerDNS recursor). On node2, added opt1/opt2 interfaces to config.xml, a pf pass rule for opt2, and an Unbound host override for app.internal, then reloaded interfaces/filter/unbound. Node3 and node4 got dedicated systemd-networkd .network files giving enp8s0 a static lan IP and pointing DNS (~internal routing domain) at their respective router. All config was verified to persist across a full one-at-a-time reboot of every node (boot_id/kern.boottime changed on each), with DNS answers and split isolation (no cross-leak) reconfirmed after each restart.
